ruleDefinitions.name: Bitbucket Secret Scanning Rule Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when secret scanning rule is deleted for the project or repository. Note: Unmapped fields: auditType.category, auditType.action

sequences.query: ((auditType.category = "Projects" OR auditType.category = "Repositories") AND (auditType.action = "Project\ secret\ scanning\ rule\ deleted" OR auditType.action = "Repository\ secret\ scanning\ rule\ deleted"))
